GAP-008 fix: the payout's follow-up step is given 25 TGas + 1 TGas per member (cap 100); each settlement records its pending follow-up; recover_stuck_settlement lets anyone finish a stuck payout 100 blocks after it started; get_pending_settlement view. State unchanged: 15 syndicates intact across the deploy. Deployed by scripts/deploy-contract.mjs.

GAP-024 fix: the release cap is cumulative over a time window of twice the exit timer (cap x (escrow at the window start + deposits since)); a failed payout gives its allowance back; a Dark Vault's epoch and exit timer advance with a new window, not with every settlement; get_release_window view; the window lives under its own storage key. State unchanged: 15 syndicates intact across the deploy. Deployed by scripts/deploy-contract.mjs.

GAP-025 fix: the exit timer is part of the policy hash depositors consent to (version 2, for new groups); a timer below 10 blocks is refused at hatch; get_policy_terms view. The 15 earlier groups are intact (checked against a pre-deploy snapshot) and keep the version-1 hash. Deployed by scripts/deploy-contract.mjs.

Security-audit fixes (GAP-026 to GAP-030): ':' refused in an order hash; a re-depositing member listed once; a settlement follow-up only finishes its own settlement; an exit lowers the release-cap base; expected_code_hash capped at 128 bytes. The 15 groups are intact (docs/lab/audit-fixes-pre-deploy-snapshot.json). Two refusals checked live (docs/lab/audit-fixes-live-check.json). The other three fixes are covered by unit tests only. Deployed by scripts/deploy-contract.mjs.

Live check: E-NONCE-CALLBACK-LIVE-01.

GAP-030 (second part): prune_syndicate also removes a group that was hatched and never funded (its creator at once; anyone after 604,800 blocks, about seven days). GAP-045/047/048: the contract itself asks the NEAR MPC signer for payments on Solana devnet and Ethereum Sepolia after checking a group's foreign-payment rules (set_foreign_policy, request_foreign_payment, on_foreign_signed, get_foreign_*), with a per-window running total, prune cleanup and finished groups still able to pay listed payees. deployments.knownDefect: GAP-049: the signer path was the bare group id, so a pruned and re-hatched id would have controlled the same Solana and Ethereum addresses as the old group. Superseded the same day, before anyone but us used the feature.

deployments.reason: GAP-049: the signer path names the group's creation block (<id>:<block>, exposed by get_foreign_path), so a freed and re-hatched group id derives different foreign addresses. The 16 groups were intact and none was in flight.
